title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-San Marcos
description: Ten under-21-safe San Marcos food runs with late availability documented by current official location pages. Check the access notes because some late service is drive-thru only or limited to weekends.

cards.entity_name: Raising Cane's — S Las Posas Road
cards.title: Chicken Fingers Until 3 or 4 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 105 S Las Posas Road, San Marcos
cards.notes: Use this for the latest indoor option on the board; confirm holiday hours before leaving and expect every order to require a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A Las Posas chicken-finger restaurant whose dining room and drive-thru remain open deep into the morning.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru service until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in San Marcos, CA — 105 S Las Posas Road
cards.access_notes: Dine-in and drive-thru: 9:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, per the current official page.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 120 N Rancho Santa Fe Road
cards.title: The 2 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 120 N Rancho Santa Fe Road, San Marcos
cards.notes: Plan this as a vehicle-based stop after 10 p.m.; consult the official page again before departure because lobby and drive-thru hours differ.
cards.short_summary: A Rancho Santa Fe Road counter-service restaurant with substantially later drive-thru access than dine-in access.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me — 120 N Rancho Santa Fe Road
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the official page shows dine-in closing at 10:00 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — Capalina Road
cards.title: A 3:30 A.M. Drive-Thru Window
cards.subtitle: 1655 Capalina Road, San Marcos
cards.notes: Choose this only when everyone can use the drive-thru after the lobby closes; verify the day-specific schedule before setting out.
cards.short_summary: An all-day-breakfast fast-food location with a drive-thru operating hours beyond its public lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: The official page lists drive-thru service as late as 3:30 a.m. on Wednesday–Saturday and until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Tuesday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1655 Capalina Road, San Marcos
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 3:30 a.m. Wednesday–Saturday and 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Tuesday. The lobby closes at 10:00 p.m. daily.

cards.title: Weekend Service Until 3 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 704 Center Drive, San Marcos
cards.notes: Save this stop for drive-thru access after 10 p.m.; check the official schedule first since weekday and weekend closing times diverge.
cards.short_summary: A second, clearly disambiguated San Marcos Taco Bell with especially late Friday and Saturday drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists the drive-thru until 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 704 Center Drive, San Marcos
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 8:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 8:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; listed dine-in closing is 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Dine-In Burgers After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 583 Grand Avenue, San Marcos
cards.notes: Head here when the group needs seating rather than a drive-thru-only handoff; recheck the posted schedule around holidays.
cards.short_summary: A Grand Avenue burger restaurant documenting both dine-in seating and closing times after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The official restaurant page states that drive-thru and dine-in seating are available and lists closing at 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — San Marcos, CA, 583 Grand Avenue
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in seating is listed as available.

cards.entity_name: Domino's Pizza — W San Marcos Boulevard
cards.title: Pizza Ordering Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 805 W San Marcos Boulevard, San Marcos
cards.notes: Open the official store page before ordering to confirm that the displayed closing time still applies to your chosen pickup or delivery method.
cards.short_summary: A named San Marcos pizza shop whose official storefront page displays a late closing time and supports online ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Domino's location page identifies the store at 805 W San Marcos Boulevard and displays that it is open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 805 W San Marcos Boulevard
cards.access_notes: The current official location page displays “Today Until 1:00 AM.” Because hours are presented dynamically, recheck before ordering.

cards.entity_name: Del Taco — S Rancho Santa Fe
cards.title: A Friday-and-Saturday 1 A.M. Stop

cards.evidence_claim: The official Del Taco page lists store hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Del Taco in San Marcos, California — 736 S Rancho Santa Fe
cards.access_notes: Store hours end at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; delivery has the same listed late cutoff.

cards.title: A Sit-Down Option Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 731 W San Marcos Boulevard, San Marcos
cards.notes: Reserve this for Friday or Saturday when the later schedule applies; check the live location page before making a sit-down plan.
cards.short_summary: A walk-in-friendly diner whose official breakfast page documents later weekend restaurant service.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Denny's location page lists restaurant service until 1:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday and describes the location as good for kids with walk-ins welcome.
cards.source_title: Denny's Breakfast — 731 W San Marcos Boulevard
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are 5:00 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and 5:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday on the cited official page.
